jutsu.name: Earth Style: Earth Dragon Bullet
jutsu.desc: The ground heaves up into a rocky dragon head that spits a volley of mud bullets.
jutsu.tip: Three signs ending on Dragon; lean forward as the dragon head rises.

jutsu.name: Earth Style: Earth Flow Spears
jutsu.desc: Sharp stone spikes burst out of the earth in a line, skewering whatever stands above them.
jutsu.tip: Snake, Rat, Bird; keep each sign crisp so Rat is not read as Snake.

jutsu.name: Earth Style: Mud Wall
jutsu.desc: Mud spat onto the ground swells into a thick earthen wall that stops attacks cold.
jutsu.tip: Slam the last sign down as if pressing a hand to the ground.

jutsu.name: Earth Style: Swamp of the Underworld
jutsu.desc: Solid ground turns into a deep bog that drags anything standing on it down into the mud.
jutsu.tip: Just Boar then Tiger. Hold Tiger and press downward as the ground softens.

jutsu.name: Fire Style: Dragon Flame Jutsu
jutsu.desc: A tight line of flame races forward like a burning fuse, often guided along wire straight to a trapped foe.
jutsu.tip: Short and quick: four signs, then aim the flame along an imaginary wire.

jutsu.name: Fire Style: Great Fireball Jutsu
jutsu.desc: Chakra kneaded in the chest is exhaled as one huge rolling sphere of flame. A rite of passage for the Uchiha clan.
jutsu.tip: Breathe in on Horse, hold Tiger like you are about to blow out a giant candle.

jutsu.name: Fire Style: Phoenix Sage Fire Jutsu
jutsu.desc: A spray of small fireballs spits out in a fan, each one steering on its own so the target cannot dodge them all.
jutsu.tip: Tiger appears twice: release the first one fully before forming it again.

jutsu.name: Fire Style: Ash Pile Burning
jutsu.desc: A cloud of chakra-laced ash is blown over the enemy, then a click of the teeth sets the whole cloud ablaze.
jutsu.tip: Drop your hands between the two Snakes so the second one counts.

jutsu.name: Fire Style: Fire Dragon Flame Bullet
jutsu.desc: A serpent of fire coils out of the mouth and lunges at the target, its body trailing a long wake of flame.
jutsu.tip: Seven signs ending on Tiger; take a deep breath before the last one.

jutsu.name: Amaterasu
jutsu.desc: Black flames ignite wherever the eye focuses. They burn for days and cannot be put out by water.
jutsu.tip: Canon needs no seals, only a Mangekyō stare; stare hard at one spot after Tiger.

jutsu.name: Blaze Style: Kagutsuchi
jutsu.desc: Black flames are shaped at will, here raised into a wall of jagged fire that shields the caster.
jutsu.tip: Canon has no seals; it is pure eye control of black fire.

jutsu.name: Scattering Thousand Crows
jutsu.desc: A storm of black crows bursts outward and fills the victim's vision, hiding the caster's real movements.
jutsu.tip: Finish on Tiger and flick your hands open as the flock scatters.

jutsu.name: Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death
jutsu.desc: The victim believes a tree has grown around them and locked them in place, while blossoms drift down and the caster closes in.
jutsu.tip: Calm, deliberate signs. Genjutsu is about control, not force.

jutsu.name: Tsukuyomi
jutsu.desc: One look traps the victim in a red-and-black world where the caster controls time; days of torment pass in a blink.
jutsu.tip: Canon needs only a Mangekyō glance; this app gives it three signs. Keep your eyes locked on the lens.

jutsu.name: Certain-Kill Ice Spears
jutsu.desc: Moisture in the air freezes into a bristling ring of ice spikes that close in on the target.
jutsu.tip: No canon seals are known; this app uses Mizunoe, Hare, Bird. Flick your fingers outward at the end.

jutsu.name: Secret Jutsu: Demonic Mirroring Ice Crystals
jutsu.desc: Panes of ice form a ring of mirrors; the caster darts between them faster than the eye can follow.
jutsu.tip: Canon uses one technique-specific seal; this app assigns four. Start on Mizunoe and end on a sharp Bird.

jutsu.name: Lightning Style: Lightning Beast Tracking Fang
jutsu.desc: Lightning in the hand takes the form of a hound that sprints at the target and follows if it dodges.
jutsu.tip: Dog first for the hound, then the Chidori trio.

jutsu.name: Chidori
jutsu.desc: Lightning chakra gathers in one hand with a sound like a thousand chirping birds, then the user charges for a piercing thrust.
jutsu.tip: After Monkey, grip your wrist and keep the open hand pointed down.

jutsu.name: Chidori Sharp Spear
jutsu.desc: The Chidori is stretched into a long blade of lightning that stabs at range.
jutsu.tip: Canon has no seals; thrust the hand forward after Dragon.

jutsu.name: Kirin
jutsu.desc: Natural lightning from storm clouds heated by fire is pulled down in the shape of a beast. It strikes far too fast to dodge.
jutsu.tip: Canon needs no seals, only a raised arm; point at the sky, then bring it down.

jutsu.name: Lightning Blade
jutsu.desc: A refined, denser Chidori said to have once cut a bolt of lightning in half.
jutsu.tip: Canon uses the same seals as Chidori; Dog was added to tell them apart.

jutsu.name: Mystical Palm Technique
jutsu.desc: Hands glow green as chakra pours into a wound, speeding the body's own repair from the inside.
jutsu.tip: Canon is a modified Ox then Tiger; the app adds Gassho to finish. Breathe slowly, like you're calming a patient.

jutsu.name: Clone Jutsu
jutsu.desc: The first trick every academy student learns: hollow copies of yourself that look real but fade at the first touch.
jutsu.tip: Keep it light. Three quick signs, then imagine two outlines of yourself stepping out to each side.

jutsu.name: Substitution Jutsu
jutsu.desc: At the instant of impact you swap places with a nearby object, leaving the attacker striking a plain wooden log.
jutsu.tip: Flow through the five signs smoothly; the log appears in a puff where you stood.

jutsu.name: Transformation Jutsu
jutsu.desc: A cloud of smoke and you wear someone else's shape: a classmate, a stranger, even a shuriken.
jutsu.tip: Finish on a crisp Ram and hold it as the smoke clears.

jutsu.name: Body Flicker Technique
jutsu.desc: Chakra-boosted footwork so fast it looks like teleporting, leaving only an afterimage behind.
jutsu.tip: Canon uses a single Tiger; this app adds Bird and Hare. Move your hands fast, then freeze.

jutsu.name: Chakra Flow
jutsu.desc: Running chakra along a weapon or your own body so a plain edge suddenly cuts, crackles or burns.
jutsu.tip: Imagine chakra running down your arm into an invisible sword.

jutsu.name: Shadow Clone Jutsu
jutsu.desc: Splits your chakra evenly into solid copies that can fight, scout and learn, then hand their memories back to you.
jutsu.tip: Canon uses a cross-shaped clone seal the detector can't see; Mizunoe stands in for it. Hold it firmly before the final Tiger.

jutsu.name: Clone Great Explosion
jutsu.desc: A shadow clone grabs hold of the enemy and then detonates its own chakra in a violent blast.
jutsu.tip: Make the clone, then snap into Bird as the trigger.

jutsu.name: Rasengan
jutsu.desc: A spinning sphere of pure chakra held in one palm, grinding into whatever it touches.
jutsu.tip: Canon needs no signs at all; this short pair is the app's trigger. Then open one palm and imagine wind spinning in it.

jutsu.name: Sand Coffin
jutsu.desc: Sand pours over the target and hardens into a tight shell, pinning them completely.
jutsu.tip: Gaara needs no seals; close your hand into a fist after the last sign.

jutsu.name: Shield of Sand
jutsu.desc: Sand rises on its own to block any attack, forming a curved barrier before the caster even reacts.
jutsu.tip: Gaara's sand moves on its own; these three signs are the app's trigger. Raise one arm as the wall forms.

jutsu.name: Eight Trigrams Sealing Style
jutsu.desc: A spiral seal written onto the body that locks something immense inside while slowly leaking its chakra to the host.
jutsu.tip: Picture a spiral of script glowing on your stomach as you press your palms together.

jutsu.name: Storm Style: Laser Circus
jutsu.desc: Beams of crackling storm chakra fire from the hands and bend through the air to chase their targets.
jutsu.tip: Five signs ending on Dragon, then spread your fingers to fire the beams.

jutsu.name: Hidden Mist Jutsu
jutsu.desc: Chakra-laced fog rolls in until the battlefield is a white blank, perfect for a silent approach.
jutsu.tip: Ox, Snake, Ram, then hold Ram still while the fog thickens.

jutsu.name: Water Style: Water Prison Jutsu
jutsu.desc: A sphere of dense water seals the target inside; the caster keeps one hand in it to hold the cage shut.
jutsu.tip: Finish by pressing both palms together, then imagine holding a heavy ball of water.

jutsu.name: Water Style: Collision Destruction
jutsu.desc: The caster spews out a staggering mass of water that turns dry land into open sea, then drives the swell into the enemy.
jutsu.tip: Canon uses a single Snake; Dragon and Mizunoe are added here. Push both hands outward on the last sign.

jutsu.name: Water Style: Water Dragon Bullet Jutsu
jutsu.desc: A column of water rises and twists into a roaring serpent that lunges at the target with crushing weight.
jutsu.tip: Canon uses 44 seals; this is the opening eight. Keep a steady rhythm, like reciting a long chant.

jutsu.name: Water Style: Water Fang Bullet
jutsu.desc: Water underfoot spirals into drill-like fangs that spring up and stab inward.
jutsu.tip: Canon is a lone Tiger; this app uses three signs. Hold Snake low, as if lifting water from the ground.

jutsu.name: Water Style: Water Shark Bomb Jutsu
jutsu.desc: Gathered water takes the shape of a hungry shark that races forward and bursts on impact.
jutsu.tip: Canon has ten seals including a clone seal; this is the seven-seal order from the detector project. Snap the final Ram like you are releasing the shark.

jutsu.name: Wind Style: Great Breakthrough
jutsu.desc: A violent blast of wind is exhaled or pushed out, flattening trees and blowing enemies off their feet.
jutsu.tip: End on Snake, then thrust both palms forward to push the gust out.

jutsu.name: Wind Style: Sickle Weasel Jutsu
jutsu.desc: One swing of a giant fan whips up a gust full of invisible blades that shreds whatever it passes.
jutsu.tip: Finish on Bird and swing your arm wide like a fan.

jutsu.name: Wind Style: Wind Cutter Jutsu
jutsu.desc: A thin, sharp slice of wind is flung forward to cut through ropes, wood or armor at range.
jutsu.tip: Finish on Dragon and slice one hand sideways like a blade.

jutsu.name: Wind Style: Vacuum Sphere
jutsu.desc: Rapid-fire vacuum bullets are spat out one after another, each one a tiny pocket of cutting air.
jutsu.tip: Only three signs: Rat, Hare, Dog. Hold Dog and puff your cheeks for the volley.

jutsu.name: Wind Style: Rasenshuriken
jutsu.desc: Wind chakra is folded into a Rasengan until it sprouts shrieking blades and cuts at the level of cells.
jutsu.tip: Canon has no signs. Raise your palm high at the end; the shuriken forms above it.

jutsu.name: Wood Style: Four-Pillar Prison Jutsu
jutsu.desc: Wooden pillars shoot up around the target and lock together into a sturdy cage.
jutsu.tip: Ram, Ox, Boar, Snake; hold Snake while the pillars close in.

jutsu.name: Wood Style: Wood Dragon Jutsu
jutsu.desc: A colossal dragon of living timber coils out of the ground and binds its prey while sapping its chakra.
jutsu.tip: Canon order minus the final technique-specific seal.

jutsu.name: Eight Gates Released Formation
jutsu.desc: Forcing open the body's chakra gates one by one unlocks impossible strength, wrapped in a boiling aura of sweat turned to steam.
jutsu.tip: A taijutsu art with no canon signs. Clench your fists after Ox and tense every muscle.

jutsu.name: Sage Mode
jutsu.desc: Sitting perfectly still, you draw nature energy into your body until your senses and strength surge.
jutsu.tip: Canon has no signs, just stillness. Press your palms, breathe, then press again, and stay still for a moment.

jutsu.name: Shadow Possession Jutsu
jutsu.desc: Your shadow stretches across the ground, latches onto the target's and forces them to copy every move you make.
jutsu.tip: Canon is a single Rat; here it's Rat, Ox, Rat. Drop your hands and break the Rat between, or it won't count twice.
